pokedexEntries.su: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

pokedexEntries.mo: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.

pokedexEntries.us: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they’re still alive.

pokedexEntries.um: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.

pokedexEntries.sw: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

pokedexEntries.sc: The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

pokedexEntries.vi: From the hollows in its arms, it fires the bones of its victims, which are all dried up after being drained of their vitality.

pokedexEntries.za: Heaps of bones lie buried beneath its castle. They came from those whom Palossand drained of vitality and left all dried up.
